notes: The verse fused the possessive לְ of לְךָ with its suffix into thine under rule 49's closing clause but marked the coordinated לְ of וּלְבָנֶיךָ unrepresented under rule 40. The ASV writes that preposition's belonging relation inside the English genitive thy sons', which is the case rule 49 closes with (לַיהוָה → is Jehovah's, and its instruction not to reach for rule 2 to split the pair). Two coordinated members of one predicate were analysed two ways with nothing in the source to license the difference. s024 now shares the unit of s025, headed on the noun carrying the lexeme.
